title: TAT-4036 feed status and last-updated time on order book and trades
description: Web Terminal: open the BTC order page, confirm the order book still renders price levels, then prove the order book and trades panels each show a feed-status badge (Live) with a last-updated timestamp. The order book is switched to the 100 aggregation first: at the default finest level the sparse testnet book makes the provider drop l2Book updates (pre-existing, see report), so at the default aggregation the recipe first proves the frozen order book is labelled Stale with its last-updated time while its levels stay on screen (AC4). Read-only: no wallet connection, no orders.

proofTargets.claim: The order book keeps rendering live price levels on the BTC order page (regression guard).
The order book panel shows a live feed status with a last-updated timestamp.
The trades panel shows its feed status with a last-updated timestamp.
When a feed errors or stops updating, the panel keeps showing its last data and labels it Disconnected or Stale with the last-updated time.
